# Sweden

> [!summary] Data available
> Moderately covered: a [[BLEnD]] file (`Swedish_Sweden`), [[RecipeDB2]] ≈1,820 recipes, [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] 373, [[FmLAMA]] 30 and [[WorldCuisines]] 27 dishes. No Swedish FCT in the vault, but strong human evidence: [[Exposome-Explorer]] 1,234 rows (NSHDC, Malmö Diet and Cancer, VIP, Swedish National Dietary Survey).

## Foods & dishes
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈1,820 recipes labelled Swedish (region "Scandinavian" 2,811); not released.
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 373 recipes tagged `swedish`; also region tag `scandinavian` 1,294. [[CulinaryDB]]: "Scandinavia" 404 recipes (no country split).
- Dish inventories: [[FmLAMA]] 30 dishes (301 rows; Janssons frestelse, pölsa, biff à la Lindström); [[WorldCuisines]] 27 dishes (8 Sweden-only; hallongrotta, tunnbröd). Ingredient lists only.
- [[BLEnD]] `Swedish_Sweden` (SemEval-2026): 105 food questions, 382 answer clusters.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table for this country is in the vault or `Backlog/`; use [[USDA FoodData Central]] (and [[FooDB]] / [[Phenol-Explorer]] for compounds) by name matching.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 142 plants; [[NPASS]] 24 pairs.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- **Human-cohort evidence:** [[Exposome-Explorer]] 1,234 rows (407 concentrations, 732 correlations, 61 cancer associations). NSHDC gives 45 cancer rows; the Swedish National Dietary Survey and VIP give intake–biomarker correlations.
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 1 record; [[KNApSAcK Family]] World lists the country (edible/medicinal species records; counts for European countries were not scraped).
- Global backbone via [[Global]]: [[FooDB]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[CTD]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions.

## Gaps
- No Swedish FCT; Nordic recipes are often pooled under "Scandinavian".
